verses.arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near to them, yet they are disregardful in [their] obliviousness.
verses.transliteration_html: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona

verses.arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.english: There does not come to them any new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it as they play around,
verses.transliteration_html: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona

verses.arabic: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.english: their hearts set on diversions. The wrongdoers secretly whisper together, [saying], ‘Is this [man] not a human being like yourselves? Will you give in to magic with open eyes?’
verses.transliteration_html: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord knows every word [spoken] in the sky and on the earth, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.english: But they said, ‘[They are] muddled dreams!’ ‘Indeed, he has fabricated it!’ ‘Indeed, he is a poet!’ ‘Let him bring us a sign, like those sent to the former generations.’
verses.transliteration_html: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona

verses.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: No town that We destroyed before them believed. Will these then have faith [if they are sent signs]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men to whom We revealed. Ask the People of the Reminder if you do not know.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
verses.english: We did not make them bodies that did not eat food, nor were they immortal.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.english: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, and We delivered them and whomever We wished, and We destroyed the transgressors.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: Certainly We have sent down to you a Book in which there is an admonition for you. Do you not exercise your reason?
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.english: How many a town We have smashed that had been wrongdoing, and We brought forth another people after it.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena
verses.transliteration_text: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
verses.english: So when they sighted Our punishment, behold, they ran away from it.
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona

verses.arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.english: ‘Do not run away! Return to the opulence you were given to enjoy and to your dwellings so that you may be questioned!’
verses.transliteration_html: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona
verses.transliteration_text: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Woe to us! We have indeed been wrongdoers!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
verses.english: That remained their cry until We turned them into a mown field, stilled [like burnt ashes].
verses.transliteration_html: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena
verses.transliteration_text: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.english: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them for play.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.english: Had We desired to take up some diversion We would have taken it up with Ourselves, were We to do [so].
verses.transliteration_html: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena
verses.transliteration_text: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it crushes its head, and behold, falsehood vanishes! And woe to you for what you allege [about Allah].
verses.transliteration_html: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
verses.english: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and those who are near Him do not disdain to worship Him, nor do they become weary.
verses.transliteration_html: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona

verses.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
verses.english: They glorify [Him] night and day, and they do not flag.
verses.transliteration_html: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
verses.english: Have they taken gods from the earth who raise [the dead]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.english: Had there been any gods in them other than Allah, they would surely have fallen apart. Clear is Allah, the Lord of the Throne, of what they allege [concerning Him].
verses.transliteration_html: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.english: He is not questioned concerning what He does, but they are questioned.
verses.transliteration_html: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona
verses.transliteration_text: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona

verses.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: Have they taken gods besides Him? Say, ‘Produce your evidence! This is a precept of those who are with me, and a precept of those [who went] before me.’ But most of them do not know the truth, and so they are disregardful.
verses.transliteration_html: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.english: We did not send any apostle before you but that We revealed to him that ‘There is no god except Me; so worship Me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni
verses.transliteration_text: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.english: They say, ‘The All-beneficent has taken offsprings.’ Immaculate is He! Indeed, they are [His] honoured servants.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: They do not venture to speak ahead of Him, and they act by His command.
verses.transliteration_html: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.english: He knows that which is before them and that which is behind them, and they do not intercede except for someone He approves of, and they are apprehensive for the fear of Him.
verses.transliteration_html: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona

verses.arabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: Should any of them say, ‘I am a god besides Him,’ We will requite him with hell. Thus do We requite the wrongdoers.
verses.transliteration_html: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: Have the faithless not regarded that the heavens and the earth were interwoven and We unravelled them, and We made every living thing out of water? Will they not then have faith?
verses.transliteration_html: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: We set firm mountains in the earth lest it should shake with them, and We made broad ways in them so that they may be guided [to their destinations].
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: We made the sky a preserved roof and yet they are disregardful of its signs.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.english: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon, each swimming in an orbit.
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: We did not give immortality to any human before you. If you are fated to die, will they live on forever?
verses.transliteration_html: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: Every soul shall taste death, and We will test you with good and ill by way of test, and to Us you will be brought back.
verses.transliteration_html: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.english: Whenever the faithless see you they only take you in derision: ‘Is this the one who remembers your gods?’ while they remain defiant towards the remembrance of the All-beneficent.
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona

verses.arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.english: Man is a creature of haste. Soon I will show you My signs. So do not ask Me to hasten.
verses.transliteration_html: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.english: If only the faithless knew about the time when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces and their backs, nor will they be helped!
verses.transliteration_html: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, it will overtake them suddenly, dumbfounding them. So they will neither be able to avert it, nor will they be granted any respite.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.english: Apostles were certainly derided before you; but those who ridiculed them were besieged by what they had been deriding.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘Who can guard you, day and night, against [the punishment of] the All-beneficent [should He want to punish you]?’ Indeed, they are disregardful of their Lord’s remembrance.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌۭ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
verses.english: Do they have gods besides Us to defend them? Neither can they help themselves, nor can they shield [the idolaters] from Us.
verses.transliteration_html: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona
verses.transliteration_text: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona

verses.arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, We have provided for them and their fathers until they lived on for long years. Do they not see how We visit the land diminishing it at its edges? Are they the ones who will prevail?
verses.transliteration_html: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘I indeed warn you by the means of revelation.’ But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: Should a whiff of your Lord’s punishment touch them, they will surely say, ‘Woe to us! We have indeed been wrongdoers!’
verses.transliteration_html: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
verses.english: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if it be the weight of a mustard seed We shall produce it and We suffice as reckoners.
verses.transliteration_html: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena
verses.transliteration_text: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءًۭ وَذِكْرًۭا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, a light and reminder for the Godwary
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.english: —those who fear their Lord in secret, and who are apprehensive of the Hour.
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona

verses.arabic: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.english: This [too] is a blessed reminder, which We have sent down. Will you then deny it?
verses.transliteration_html: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We had given Abraham his probity before, and We knew him
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
verses.english: when he said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you keep on clinging?’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: He said, ‘Certainly you and your fathers have been in manifest error.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Are you telling the truth, or are you [just] kidding?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Indeed, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who originated them, and I affirm that.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena

verses.arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.english: By Allah, I will devise a stratagem against your idols after you have gone away.’
verses.transliteration_html: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena
verses.transliteration_text: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًۭا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: So he broke them into pieces—all except the biggest of them—so that they might come back to it.
verses.transliteration_html: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Whoever has done this to Our gods?! He is indeed a wrongdoer!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًۭى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.english: They said, ‘We heard a young man mentioning them. He is called ‘‘Abraham.’’ ’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Bring him before the people’s eyes so that they may bear witness [against him].’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.english: They said, ‘Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘No, it was this biggest one of them who did it! Ask them, if they can speak.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona

verses.arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.english: Thereat they came to themselves and said [to one another], ‘Indeed it is you who are the wrongdoers!’
verses.transliteration_html: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona
verses.transliteration_text: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.english: Then they hung their heads. [However, they said,] ‘You certainly know that they cannot speak.’
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
verses.english: He said, ‘Then, do you worship besides Allah that which cannot cause you any benefit or harm?
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la afataAAbudoona min dooni All<u>a</u>hi m<u>a</u> l<u>a</u> yanfaAAukum shayan wal<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>urrukum
verses.transliteration_text: Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum

verses.arabic: أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: Fie on you and what you worship besides Allah! Do you not exercise your reason?’
verses.transliteration_html: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Burn him, and help your gods, if you are to do anything!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.english: We said, ‘O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema
verses.transliteration_text: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema

verses.arabic: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
verses.english: They plotted to harm him, but We made them the biggest losers.
verses.transliteration_html: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena
verses.transliteration_text: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: We delivered him and Lot toward the land, which We have blessed for all nations.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًۭ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
verses.english: And We gave him Isaac, and Jacob as well for a grandson, and each of them We made righteous.
verses.transliteration_html: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena
verses.transliteration_text: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.english: We made them imams, guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them [concerning] the performance of good deeds, the maintenance of prayers, and the giving of zakat, and they used to worship Us.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena

verses.arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.english: We gave judgement and knowledge to Lot, and We delivered him from the town which used to commit vicious acts. Indeed, they were an evil and depraved lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena

verses.arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.english: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was one of the righteous.
verses.transliteration_html: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena
verses.transliteration_text: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.english: And before that Noah, when he called out, We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great agony.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: And We helped him against the people who denied Our signs. They were indeed an evil lot; so We drowned them all.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] David and Solomon when they gave judgement concerning the tillage when the sheep of some people strayed into it by night, and We were witness to their judgement.
verses.transliteration_html: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena
verses.transliteration_text: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena

verses.arabic: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.english: We gave its understanding to Solomon, and to each We gave judgement and knowledge. We disposed the mountains and the birds to glorify [Us] with David, and We have been the doer [of these things].
verses.transliteration_html: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena
verses.transliteration_text: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena

verses.arabic: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
verses.english: We taught him the making of coats of mail for you, to protect you from your [own] violence. Will you then be grateful?
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona

verses.arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: And [We disposed] for Solomon the tempestuous wind which blew by his command toward the land which We have blessed, and We have knowledge of all things.
verses.transliteration_html: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.english: Among the devils were some who dived for him and performed tasks other than that, and We were watchful over them.
verses.transliteration_html: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena
verses.transliteration_text: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena

verses.arabic: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] Job, when he called out to his Lord, ‘Indeed distress has befallen me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.english: So We answered his prayer and removed his distress, and We gave him [back] his family along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for the devout.
verses.transliteration_html: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena
verses.transliteration_text: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena

verses.arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] Ishmael, Idris, and Dhul-Kifl—each of them was among the patient.
verses.transliteration_html: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena
verses.transliteration_text: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena

verses.arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.english: We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were among the righteous.
verses.transliteration_html: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena
verses.transliteration_text: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًۭا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] the Man of the Fish, when he left in a rage, thinking that We would not put him to hardship. Then he cried out in the darkness, ‘There is no god except You! You are immaculate! I have indeed been among the wrongdoers!’
verses.transliteration_html: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: So We answered his prayer and delivered him from the agony; and thus do We deliver the faithful.
verses.transliteration_html: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena

verses.arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] Zechariah, when he cried out to his Lord, ‘My Lord! Do not leave me without an heir, and You are the best of inheritors.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena
verses.transliteration_text: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena

verses.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًۭا وَرَهَبًۭا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
verses.english: So We answered his prayer, and gave him John, and cured for him his wife [of infertility]. Indeed, they were active in [performing] good works, and they would supplicate Us with eagerness and awe and were humble before Us.
verses.transliteration_html: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: And [remember] her who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her Our spirit, and made her and her son a sign for all the nations.
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.english: Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord. So worship Me.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni

verses.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.english: They have fragmented their religion among themselves, but everyone of them will return to Us.
verses.transliteration_html: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ
verses.english: Whoever is faithful and does righteous deeds, his endeavour shall not go unappreciated, and We will indeed record it for him.
verses.transliteration_html: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona

verses.arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.english: It is forbidden for [the people of] any town that We have destroyed [to return to the world]: they shall not return,
verses.transliteration_html: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍۢ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.english: until when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they race down from every slope,
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona

verses.arabic: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: and the true promise draws near [to its fulfillment], behold, the faithless will look on with a fixed gaze: ‘Woe to us! We have certainly been oblivious of this! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
verses.english: Indeed you and what [idols] you worship besides Allah shall be fuel for hell, and you will enter it.
verses.transliteration_html: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةًۭ مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: Had they been gods, they would not have entered it, and they will all remain in it [forever].
verses.transliteration_html: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.english: Their lot therein will be groaning, and they will not hear anything in it.
verses.transliteration_html: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
verses.english: Indeed those to whom there has gone beforehand [the promise of] the best reward from Us will be kept away from it.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: They will not hear even its faint sound and they will remain [forever] in what their souls desire.
verses.transliteration_html: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona

verses.arabic: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: The Great Terror will not upset them, and the angels will receive them [saying]: ‘This is your day which you were promised.’
verses.transliteration_html: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍۢ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.english: The day We shall roll up the heaven, like rolling of the scrolls [meant] for writings. We will bring it back just as We began the first creation—a promise [binding] on Us. [That] indeed We will do.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
verses.english: Certainly We wrote in the Psalms, after the Torah: ‘Indeed My righteous servants shall inherit the earth.’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًۭا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed in this a proclamation for a devout people.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: We did not send you but as a mercy to all the nations.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So will you submit?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍۢ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed to you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been promised is far or near.
verses.transliteration_html: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.english: Indeed He knows whatever is spoken aloud, and He knows whatever you conceal.
verses.transliteration_html: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona
verses.transliteration_text: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona

verses.arabic: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌۭ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.english: I do not know—maybe it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin
verses.transliteration_text: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin

verses.arabic: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Judge [between us and the polytheists] with justice.’ ‘Our Lord is the All-beneficent; [He is our] resort against what you allege.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona
